# How do I escape?
This page explains how to cause a containment breach when you are assigned the role of SCP-173.
[textlink="General information about the Sculpture" link="Scp173About"]
[textlink="More information on containing the Sculpture as facility personnel" link="Scp173Containment"]
## Main method
This method involves using the [bold]"Soil Tile"[/bold] ability, which becomes available once the safe-time timer ends.
[textlink="More information about the abilities" link="Scp173Abilities"]
Each use of the ability releases a certain amount of a special substance. When the contamination meter fills for the first time, the blast doors in the containment chamber open. However, the meter also has a second stage that causes everything nearby to explode when filled. Use this to your advantage!
## How do I resist capture?
Once you leave your containment chamber, the personnel will begin trying to capture you. Your task is to resist them.
Try to attack isolated targets only. You are extremely vulnerable against a crowd. Use the "Leap" ability offensively if there are two people in front of you without "Stasis Drops"; otherwise, use it to retreat when you are facing more than four people.
